But several statements are not grounded in the packet, and the next steps and citations are muddled, so an investigator would have to redo some of the work.","problems":["The headline and rationale say the 99215 share is above the all-provider rate 'in every complexity stratum' and 'roughly two to three times' at every level. The card shows ratios of about 3.2x (0 conditions), 2.0x, 2.4x, 2.1x, 2.2x and 1.7x (5+), so 'two to three times' is only approximate and 1.7x falls outside it.","The summary cites 'flagged notes C0107449, C0107475, C0108428 and C0107941', and none of these appear on the evidence card. They may come from tool output, but they are not verifiable here and the packet does not show why they were flagged.","The 'repeated time entries' claim is not on the card.","The 'problems 13%' note-check figure and the 15% comparison rate are not on the card. The 15% is close to the card's all-provider 99215 rate of 0.147, but the card gives that as a below-billed rate for 99215 specifically, so the comparison is loosely framed.","The next step asks for a targeted sample of 99215 charts but starts with C0107874 and C0108507, which are 99213 claims already documented below the billed level. It does not start with the low-complexity 99215 claims the narrative recommends, so the narrative and next steps are inconsistent.","The example claims cited (C0107874, C0108507) are not the ones the narrative uses to support its points. The narrative's cited low-complexity examples are C0107257, C0107609, C0107790 and C0107751, and these are missing from the cited_claim_ids list.","The summary says documented 99215s were supported at high MDM, yet it also suggests templating without evidence. The 'templated notes' idea is speculative, though it is hedged as weak and not proof.","It mentions 2 of 20 data-heavy notes with no lab line, but does not note that the 2 documented 99213s below billed level go in the opposite direction from upcoding."]}
